b) Reference: olives are about 2.2 cm long. The plate spans roughly 11-12 olive lengths across its width (about 25 cm), which is consistent with 24-26 cm.
Final width: 25 cm, area = 625 cm².

STEP 4 - Hidden food: no base layer is visible under the items on this flat plate, so nothing is added.

STEP 5 - Total ≈ 112 + 110 + 67 = 289 g.
Energy: olives 112 g x 1.15 = 129 kcal; sprouts 110 g x 0.43 = 47 kcal; celery 67 g x 0.16 = 11 kcal. Total ≈ 187 kcal.
